name: Ash reshteh
description: Thick soup of herbs, beans and noodles, finished with kashk and fried mint.

tcm.note: A thick herb and pulse soup.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the herbs and kashk.

histamine.note: Kashk is dried fermented whey — that spoonful on top is what rates the bowl.

nutrition.highlight: the kashk on top is the signature
